benchmark.name: DrivingGen: A Comprehensive Benchmark for Generative Video World Models in Autonomous Driving

upstream.dataset_revision_note: Pinned to the immutable HF commit whose README card declares 222 eval examples in each of open_domain and ego_condition. The dataset page separately displays 22,866 rows; these may represent image/frame rows rather than clips. The paper reports 200 evaluation samples per track. Keep the count discrepancy open until the revision's actual files are enumerated and mapped to unique video/clip IDs.
upstream.third_party_provenance_note: Open-domain samples are internet-sourced; ego-conditioned samples aggregate multiple source datasets. Review source-video redistribution and commercial-use rights separately from repository/card license metadata.

open_domain.purpose: open-domain generalization across geography, weather, time of day and diverse driving interactions

ego_conditioned.purpose: controllability of generated video trajectories relative to supplied ego motion

sample_count_discrepancy.description: Paper describes 200 samples per track (400 total); the current Hugging Face README metadata reports 222 eval examples for each track; the dataset page also shows 22,866 rows. These quantities may refer to different revisions or row/frame/sample units.
required_resolution: enumerate exact video/sample IDs per track
reconcile paper sample IDs vs hosted dataset card IDs
retain missing/extra IDs as typed outcomes
compare exact files and parent commit for pinned HF revision 935e0a40cd489305a206abe89f31d8854495098b

row_count_diagnostic.hypothesis: The viewer's 22,866 rows may represent flattened frame-level or row-level data associated with 222 clip-level examples; this is not established by the card metadata or directory listing.
row_count_diagnostic.relationship_to_paper_video_example: The upstream repository shows a 101-frame generation example; the numerical difference is not explained and must not be silently attributed to two extra frames.
row_count_diagnostic.resolution: Inspect the pinned ZIP/dataset builder and HF viewer feature schema to determine row units and whether rows are clips, frames, image entries, or a flattened representation.

generation_example.source: upstream repository Wan2.2-14B example; not assumed universal for every model

trajectory_extraction.provenance_warning: Extracted trajectories are estimates from generated video, not perfect physical ground truth. Record estimator version, confidence, failures, tracking switches and invalid segments separately from generative model metrics.

interpretation.use: A small qualitative South African scene-audit seed only. Do not treat filenames or captions as jurisdiction labels or a statistically representative LHT sample.

comparability_controls.claim_boundary: Generative video and trajectory metrics do not by themselves establish downstream planner utility, causal actor response, closed-loop driving safety or operational outcomes.

arms: planner with generated future-scene hypotheses at matched compute and latency
prospective_sam_experiment.success_condition: show downstream decision value at matched compute without degrading feasibility, actor identity, uncertainty calibration, tail strata or runtime/fallback constraints
